name: psychology
description: AI getting stronger while your own advantage feels unclear? Connect Psychology in a supported chat, then distil the memories and past chats you choose into grounded strengths and likely answers for your goal. Psychology also offers published self-assessments and practical reflection.

interface.shortDescription: Distil your chosen AI memories and chats into strengths and likely next answers.
interface.longDescription: Psychology supports structured self-reflection with published or clearly labelled psychometric instruments and plain-language interpretation. It is not therapy, diagnosis, or treatment. A host is supported only after its exact version completes a recorded OAuth authorization-code and S256 PKCE acceptance test. Signed-in storage reads require the applicable consent and an explicit per-session source choice; stored results, profiles, and journal content are never loaded by default. Referral results are informational leads only, and users independently verify credentials, availability, scope, and suitability.
